paragraphs: Rav Ukva bar Chinena of Perishna.
Mentioned in Pesachim 91a: he posed a contradiction to Rava.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied heading has חיננא; earlier machine OCR had חינגא. מפרישנא is read as “of/from Perishna,” with מ as the prefix, without identifying a modern location.

רמי is the verb “posed a contradiction,” not the personal name Rami. Ukva poses it to Rava. צא. gives Pesachim 91a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. Rav is explicit in the heading.
